1.consolidated_definition: Tronco grueso de un árbol, que arrimado al borde de un barranco, lo usaban para ñangotarse sobre él y evacuar el vientre. Esto, antiguamente en las fincas rústicas.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Sturdy trunk of a tree, placed against the edge of a ravine, which was used to squat over it and evacuate one's bowels. This practice was formerly common in rural estates.
